title: Zesty Spicy Moroccan Macaroni Seffa
description: A spicy and snappy Moroccan dish featuring macaroni, steamed to perfection with a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a light and satisfying meal. This shojin-friendly seffa is a unique twist on traditional Moroccan cuisine.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Steam the cooked macaroni in a steamer basket over boiling water for 5 minutes, or until heated through.
To assemble the seffa, place the steamed macaroni in a large serving dish and top with the spicy onion mixture.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Traditionally, seffa is served in a decorative mound, so feel free to get creative with the presentation.
Leftovers can be refrigerated for up to 3 days and reheated as needed.
